scope: Melee and instant specials, cache revision 240. Registration is measured by the generated registry TSV; it is not a claim of full OSRS content parity.
evidence: Current-cache sa_energy_requirements and sa_descriptions, preserved in special-attack-cache.tsv; all mapped identifiers validated against revision240 in tests.

https://github.com/weirdgloop/osrs-dps-calc/blob/main/src/lib/PlayerVsNPCCalc.ts — RuneScape Wiki calculator implementation reviewed to cross-check special damage/accuracy stages; no implementation copied.

https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Barrelchest_anchor_%28bh%29_%28beta%29 — quoted Jagex ModAsh clarification: first eligible stat, Defence then Attack etc; currentcache supplies released energy/damage/speed values.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Dragon_longsword — distinction between ordinary damage-only special and BH accuracy/speed bonus.
https://oldschool.runescape.wiki/w/Crystal_halberd — large-target double hit and three-tile sweep mechanics.

mechanics.Sweep: Dragon/crystal halberd: slash defence, +10% damage, second hit with 0.75 accuracy against large targets; three-tile multiway sweep for small targets with attack validation and line of sight.
mechanics.Pulverize: Elder maul: +25% accuracy, normal damage, 35% of current defence removed after successful damage, two-tick hit delay.
mechanics.Smash: Dragon warhammer variants only: +50% damage, 30% current-defence reduction. Statius variants remain missing.
mechanics.Puncture: Dragon dagger: two independent accuracy rolls, +15% accuracy/damage, slash defence.
mechanics.Abyssal Puncture: Two damage rolls sharing successful first accuracy roll; normal 0.85 damage and BH imbued 0.95 damage; +25% accuracy.
mechanics.The Judgement: Double accuracy. Floors the 1.1 intermediate godsword boost before the additional 1.25 multiplier.
mechanics.Warstrike: Double accuracy. Floors 1.1 then 1.1 damage; drains current combat levels sequentially without negative values.
mechanics.Healing Blade: Double accuracy, +10% damage; restores half damage in HP (minimum10) and quarter in Prayer (minimum5) without overhealing.
mechanics.Ice Cleave: Double accuracy, +10% damage; freeze after hit and respects NPC freeze resistance and existing freeze immunity.
mechanics.Energy Drain: +25% accuracy and transfers 10% of the target's current run energy for PvP, capped at full energy.
mechanics.Eviscerate: Normal/ornament Fang only: +50% accuracy, damage from15% through true maximum; BR cache metadata remains open.
mechanics.Penance: Adds0.5% damage per missing Prayer point; boosted Prayer never produces a negative damage bonus.
mechanics.Hammer Blow: +50% accuracy; five damage added even when the normal damage roll misses.
mechanics.Sunder: Double accuracy, +10% damage (BH +25%). Drains first eligible Defence/Attack/Ranged/Magic stat by10% damage, floor1, without spillover; BH next attack4ticks on success.
mechanics.Disrupt: Voidwaker registered as melee weapon but queues guaranteed MAGIC damage from50% to150% of pre-special melee max. Does not inherit Corp's melee reduction; retains PvP Elysian reduction and magic hit processing.
mechanics.Powerstab: Dragon2h targets up to14 surrounding enemies through multiway/LoS/attack validation; BR Unarmed metadata variant remains open.
mechanics.Cleave: Normal longsword +25% damage only; BH adds +25% accuracy and4tick next attack. Normal's old erroneous accuracy bonus removed.
mechanics.Instant tools: Explicit known axe/harpoon/pickaxe cosmetic/empty/crystal/Leagues aliases; felling axes use two-handed animation. Excalibur +8 Defence. Dragon battleaxe drains four current stats10%, boosts Strength by10 plus one-quarter drained amount.

remaining_family_reasons.Eviscerate: Normal/ornament Fang implemented; BR variant is decoded Unarmed and needs its normal-attack metadata/bonuses validated together.
remaining_family_reasons.Powerstab: Normal/corrupted dragon2h implemented; BR variant is decoded Unarmed and needs its normal-attack metadata/bonuses validated together.
remaining_family_reasons.Power of Death: Staff of the dead/light/balance requires a timed melee-reduction buff that expires on unequip and stacks correctly with protection prayer; no generic hit substitute added.
remaining_family_reasons.Soul Rend: Eye of Ayak is decoded Unarmed and requires normal charged-staff attacks, doubled-accuracy special,30% damage bonus and persistent magic-defence reduction.
remaining_family_reasons.Backstab: Bone dagger first-attack accuracy override and defence-drain semantics have no handler.
remaining_family_reasons.Bear Down: Ursine chainmace requires its charged weapon lifecycle, timed damage, agility drain and run suppression.
remaining_family_reasons.Behead: Soulreaper stack accumulation, HP accounting, stack consumption and special scaling are not implemented together.
remaining_family_reasons.Binding Tentacle: Tentacle requires bind and poison effects, including exact miss behaviour and charge lifecycle.
remaining_family_reasons.Blood Sacrifice: Ancient godsword requires a delayed, movement-cancellable mark with separate PvP healing cap.
remaining_family_reasons.Blood infusion: Dual macuahuitl requires full Bloodrager set validation and guaranteed set proc plus HP sacrifice.
remaining_family_reasons.Brand: Infernal tecpatl is decoded Unarmed; dedicated four-hit special and new-item metadata require qualification.
remaining_family_reasons.Break Shackles: Blue moon requires full-set validation, reading and clearing a current bind, and scaling from its remaining duration.
remaining_family_reasons.Brutal Swing: Crimson kisten is decoded Unarmed; four-roll success-dependent damage distribution is not implemented.
remaining_family_reasons.Burning barrage: Burning/bone claws require exact three-roll damage distribution plus stackable timed burn effects.
remaining_family_reasons.Celebrate: Dragon candle cosmetic special is not implemented.
remaining_family_reasons.Crystalline Severance: Echo Gauntlet special depends on the Leagues encounter and boss prayer-disable mechanics.
remaining_family_reasons.Echo slash: Leagues godsword combines several effects, including the unimplemented Ancient godsword mark.
remaining_family_reasons.Entice: Soulflame horn is decoded Unarmed and requires per-ally energy accounting plus a next-attack accuracy buff.
remaining_family_reasons.Favour of the War God: Ancient mace requires protection-prayer bypass and Prayer drain/overheal; existing public melee queue API cannot express that bypass.
remaining_family_reasons.Feint: Vesta longsword requires a separate defence-roll multiplier and restricted PvP item behavior.
remaining_family_reasons.Ferocity: Fang of the hound is decoded Unarmed; an immediate extra attack requires scheduling outside the normal next-attack loop.
remaining_family_reasons.Flames of Ralos: Arkan blade is decoded Unarmed and requires timed burning damage.
remaining_family_reasons.Impale: Rune claws require verified delay and attack/strength-level multipliers rather than an arbitrary max-hit multiplier.
remaining_family_reasons.Lightning Strike: Deadman khopesh is decoded Unarmed and requires different PvP/PvM lightning hit distributions.
remaining_family_reasons.Lingering Lightning: Thunder khopesh requires a persistent location-based lightning attack after the initial pair of hits.
remaining_family_reasons.Liquify: Brine sabre requires underwater-only authorization and damage-derived stat boosts.
remaining_family_reasons.Power of the Gods: Deadman dogsword combines all godsword effects with special PvP sacrifice caps; decoded Unarmed.
remaining_family_reasons.Quick Smash: Granite maul requires an immediate extra attack and correct double-click/target scheduling, not a normal delayed hit.
remaining_family_reasons.Retainer: Ivandis/blisterwood require vampyre-type and health validation plus quest transformation/trapping behavior.
remaining_family_reasons.Saradomin's Lightning: Ordinary and blessed swords have different physical/magic damage behavior; no registered handler yet.
remaining_family_reasons.Seeking Lunge: Sunspear is decoded Unarmed; exact70% damage and low-HP accuracy behavior need a dedicated handler.
remaining_family_reasons.Sever: Dragon scimitar requires temporarily disabling only protection prayers and enforcing that lock in prayer activation.
remaining_family_reasons.Shatter: Normal dragon mace implemented; BH imbued still requires its defence-roll reduction to60%.
remaining_family_reasons.Shield Bash: Dinh's requires validated large-area targeting and its current additional primary-hit/stat-drain behavior.
remaining_family_reasons.Shove: Dragon/Zamorak spears and hasta require validated knockback, path/collision checks and stun lifecycle.
remaining_family_reasons.Slice and Dice: Dragon claws require the exact four-accuracy-roll damage distribution and miss branches; no generic four-normal-hit substitute added.
remaining_family_reasons.Smash: Dragon warhammer implemented; Statius variants require their minimum-damage distribution and PvP restrictions.
remaining_family_reasons.Sol Slam: Sol weapon requires immediate area damage and Prayer-bonus scaling.
remaining_family_reasons.Spear Wall: Vesta spear requires multiway area targeting followed by temporary melee/ranged immunity.
remaining_family_reasons.Tumeken's Light: Sun partisan is decoded Unarmed and requires ToA-only context,50 Prayer sacrifice and simultaneous restore/cure effects.
remaining_family_reasons.Unleash: Dragon hasta consumes a variable amount of remaining energy; specialized cache energy values cannot use fixed-cost generic handlers.
remaining_family_reasons.Virulence: Noxious halberd requires consuming current poison state and preserving a one-shot next-attack damage bonus.
remaining_family_reasons.Weaken: Darklight/Arclight/Emberlight require demon-aware stat reductions; Arclight also lacks a coherent existing charge lifecycle.
remaining_family_reasons.Wild Stab: Dragon sword requires protection-prayer bypass; existing public melee queue API cannot express it safely.
remaining_family_reasons.Wrath of Amascut: Corruption partisan requires ToA-only context and a timed incoming-damage debuff.

cross_cutting_limits: Area-target broadphase searches NPC southwest anchors before checking their full footprint. A large secondary NPC whose anchor is outside the search radius but whose footprint overlaps the area may be omitted. Primary targets and halberd large-primary double hits are unaffected.

Halberd/dragon2h secondary area targets are NPC-only. Existing PvP hook Pass means not-vetoed, not positively eligible, so new area attacks do not use it to authorize damage to player bystanders. Primary PvP targets remain handled by the normal combat script.
A registered handler and mapped cache symbol do not prove full live combat parity. Final registry report distinguishes registration from qualification.
Battle Royale items decoded as Unarmed need separate normal-attack metadata/dispatch testing. Cosmetic model compatibility is not inferred from a name.
BH/corrupted aliases have implemented special arithmetic, but a complete Bounty Hunter-only equipment restriction system is not present in this server.
Special encounter exceptions, e.g. Tekton first-hit guarantee/failed-hit drain and boss stat floors, are not claimed implemented by these general weapon handlers.
Delayed effects use source/target assignment and target UID validation; no live user-client combat was performed during unit qualification.

The server's queued-hit API can modify NPC damage again at impact. Healing/stat drains currently use the queued hit's damage, matching other existing effects but not a guarantee of final post-script damage.
